preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= arr[i] <= 10**4 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the array must match the specified number of elements n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == -1 or (stdout[i] in arr and arr.index(stdout[i]) > i) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must either be -1 or the closest element to the right with a greater frequency.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == -1 or (arr.count(stdout[i]) > arr.count(arr[i])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must have a greater frequency than the corresponding input element.
